about_the_game:
Game Background
The Wheel of Reincarnation in this world has been corrupted by polluted spiritual energy, transforming into an AI entity. Through advanced AI technology, it has broken the boundaries of life's end, merging flesh, soul, and machinery to form a new life system. However, the surviving humans and demonic races do not accept this practice. The protagonist will explore this world where remnants of humanity, mechanical AI, and demons coexist, uncovering the conflicts and entanglements among various factions.

Game Setting
This game is the final installment in the Liuyin trilogy, adopting a Chinese fantasy cyberpunk style to complete the series' overarching世界观 (worldview).

Combat System
The game emphasizes aggressive play and counter-defense mechanics. In addition to standard actions like blocking and dodging, it enhances the series' exploration-based collection system, featuring 2 sets of martial arts and 1 passive skill system.

Equipment System
The game introduces weapons, soul firearms, and cloak equipment. Players can obtain new gear with unique traits by defeating bosses or exploring, significantly improving replayability.

Level Design
Levels are intricately designed with labyrinthine box-style layouts, creating a sense of progression and discovery. There are 8 major zones with distinct themes and numerous smaller areas.

Endings
The game features multiple branching paths and endings, encouraging players to replay for different outcomes.

short_description: A 3D cyber-fantasy ARPG with metroidvania levels & multiple endings. Combat rewards aggression – hesitation means defeat. In a world where the Wheel of Reincarnation, corrupted by tainted energy, became an AI that merged flesh, souls, and machines to create new life, survivors reject this evolution.
supported_languages: English, Simplified Chinese, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Japanese, Traditional Chinese, Portuguese - Portugal, Korean
